annotations.description: Lightning Visionary could attack for 2 unblocked damage. The opponent's only creature (Turntimber Basilisk) has summoning sickness and cannot block, and all opponent's lands are tapped so no combat tricks are possible. This is risk-free damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Did not attack with Lightning Visionary
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Lightning Visionary for 2 free damage, then proceed to second main phase to play Mountain and cast spells.

annotations.description: Passed with 3 mana available and Master's Rebuke in hand, missing the chance to kill Lightning Visionary (2/1) with Turntimber Basilisk's 2 power via Master's Rebuke. This would have cleared the only blocker, allowing Basilisk to attack freely. Without removing it, the Basilisk can't attack profitably since it would trade with the Visionary in combat.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting anything in precombat main phase.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Master's Rebuke targeting Turntimber Basilisk and Lightning Visionary to kill the Visionary, then attack with the unblocked Basilisk for 2 damage.

annotations.description: Turntimber Basilisk (2/1 deathtouch) has a favorable attack into Lightning Visionary (2/1). If blocked, the trade eliminates the opponent's only creature (deathtouch ensures the kill regardless of prowess pump). If unblocked, it deals 2 damage. The Basilisk isn't needed on defense since the Visionary won't profitably attack into deathtouch. Additionally, GPT53C has Master's Rebuke and Hunter's Insight in hand as potential combat tricks with 3 mana available.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with Turntimber Basilisk.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Turntimber Basilisk. If blocked by Lightning Visionary, the favorable trade removes the opponent's only creature. If unblocked, deal 2 damage. Could also hold up Hunter's Insight (2G) to potentially draw cards if unblocked, or Master's Rebuke (1G) to remove the Visionary.

annotations.description: Turntimber Basilisk has deathtouch and trample (from Garruk's +1), so blocking with a 1/1 token only saves 1 life (4 trample damage instead of 5). The Goblin Wizard token with prowess has future value — o3 Memoir has Thrill of Possibility and Goblin Wizardry in the graveyard suggesting a noncreature-spell-heavy deck that makes prowess tokens worth more than 1 life at 20 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Turntimber Basilisk with a 1/1 Goblin Wizard token, saving 1 life but losing the token.
annotations.betterLine: Don't block — take 5 damage (going to 15) and preserve both prowess tokens for future attacks. At 20 life, 1 point saved is worth less than a prowess creature that could deal more damage over subsequent turns.

annotations.description: Casting Hunter's Insight while Garruk's +1 ability is still on the stack means the opponent can respond by killing the 2/1 Turntimber Basilisk before it gets the +3/+3 buff. The Basilisk at 1 toughness dies to any burn spell. If the opponent has even a Shock or similar, both Hunter's Insight and the Garruk activation are wasted.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Hunter's Insight in response to Garruk's +1 ability (while Basilisk is still 2/1)
annotations.betterLine: Let Garruk's +1 resolve first, making Basilisk a 5/4 with trample, then cast Hunter's Insight in the precombat main phase. The 5/4 body is much harder to remove with burn, protecting the Hunter's Insight investment.

annotations.description: Pillar of Flame targeted Turntimber Basilisk instead of Garruk, Unleashed. Garruk at 4 loyalty is the primary threat on the board, generating card advantage and tokens every turn. Dealing 2 to Garruk would bring it to 2 loyalty, making it very vulnerable to being attacked down next turn by Kinetic Augur (which would have 3 power after Pillar goes to graveyard) or the Goblin token. The Basilisk is only a 2/1 and less threatening than an active planeswalker.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Turntimber Basilisk with Pillar of Flame, killing it
annotations.betterLine: Target Garruk, Unleashed with Pillar of Flame to reduce it to 2 loyalty, then attack it down next turn with Kinetic Augur (3 power with trample)

annotations.description: Cast Ranger's Guile in response to the opponent's Kinetic Augur ETB draw trigger, which doesn't threaten any of GPT53C Teach's creatures. The +1/+1 and hexproof are completely unnecessary here - there's nothing to protect against. This wastes a card that could later save a key creature (like Garruk's Harbinger or Rampaging Baloths) from removal.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Ranger's Guile on Turntimber Basilisk in response to Kinetic Augur's ETB trigger (discard/draw), wasting the card and 1 mana for no meaningful effect.
annotations.betterLine: Pass priority to let the Kinetic Augur ETB resolve, saving Ranger's Guile to protect an important creature from actual removal later. Then proceed to play Forest and develop the board toward casting Zendikar's Roil or Rampaging Baloths.

annotations.description: With a land drop still available (Forest in hand), GPT53C Teach could play Forest first to have 6 mana, then cast Rampaging Baloths (6/6 trample, makes 4/4 tokens on landfall) instead of Zendikar's Roil (enchantment that makes 2/2 tokens on landfall). Baloths is strictly superior - bigger body, bigger tokens, and applies immediate board pressure against an opponent at 15 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Zendikar's Roil for 5 mana without first playing the Forest land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Forest from hand first (land drop), then cast Rampaging Baloths for {4}{G}{G} using all 6 available mana. This gives a 6/6 trample creature plus 4/4 tokens on future landfall triggers instead of just 2/2 tokens.

annotations.description: Used Garruk's +1 ability targeting the opponent's Kinetic Augur, giving it +3/+3 and trample (making it a 6/7 trampler). This buffs the opponent's creature for no benefit.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted opponent's Kinetic Augur with Garruk's +1, giving the opponent's creature +3/+3 and trample.
annotations.betterLine: Target own Turntimber Basilisk with Garruk's +1 to make it a 5/4 trampler, then attack. Alternatively, use Garruk's -2 to create a 3/3 Beast token instead.

annotations.description: By targeting Garruk with all 3 damage from Flames of the Firebrand instead of dealing 3 to the opponent's face, the player missed the opportunity to reduce Chandra's Incinerator's cost by 3 (to {2}{R}), enabling casting the 6/6 trampler this same turn with the remaining 3 mana. A 6/6 trampler on board is a massive threat that could race the opponent, and Incinerator's triggered ability would let future pings (e.g. Chandra's Magmutt) also deal damage to Garruk or other creatures.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Garruk, Unleashed with Flames of the Firebrand to kill the planeswalker at 3 loyalty.
annotations.betterLine: Target GPT53C Teach (opponent) with all 3 damage from Flames of the Firebrand, then cast Chandra's Incinerator for {2}{R} (reduced by 3). This deploys a 6/6 trampler while still having a path to deal with Garruk via Incinerator's triggered ability on subsequent turns.

annotations.description: Goblin Wizard Token (2/2) could have attacked Garruk, Unleashed (at 1 loyalty) with no possible blockers (Turntimber Basilisk is tapped, Elemental Token is sick). Killing Garruk for free removes a significant threat that can pump creatures or generate tokens.
annotations.actionTaken: Declared no attackers, passing the combat phase entirely.
annotations.betterLine: Attack Garruk, Unleashed with the Goblin Wizard Token to destroy the planeswalker at 1 loyalty for free.

annotations.description: Used Hunter's Edge (4 mana, a card) to kill a sick Chandra's Magmutt that couldn't block or attack this turn, when the Turntimber Basilisk already had deathtouch and +3/+3 from Garruk. This wasted a card and 4 mana for minimal value, leaving only 3 mana for deploying threats instead of 7.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Hunter's Edge to fight-kill the opponent's sick Chandra's Magmutt
annotations.betterLine: Cast Rampaging Baloths (6 mana) to deploy a 6/6 trampler with landfall token generation, or cast Garruk's Harbinger (3 mana) to deploy a threat and still have 4 mana for Primeval Herald. The Magmutt could be dealt with later or simply attacked past with the massive board.

annotations.description: With 7 life facing 12 damage (Turntimber Basilisk 3/2, Garruk's Harbinger 7/6 trample, Elemental Token 2/2), only blocking the Basilisk with Young Pyromancer leaves 9 unblocked damage — lethal. Living Lightning (3/2) could also block despite being 'sick' (summoning sickness doesn't prevent blocking). Assigning Living Lightning to block the 7/6 trampling Harbinger would reduce trample damage to 4, bringing total to 4+2=6, surviving at 1 life. Living Lightning's death trigger would also return an instant/sorcery from graveyard.
annotations.actionTaken: Only blocked Turntimber Basilisk with Young Pyromancer, leaving 9 damage unblocked (lethal at 7 life)
annotations.betterLine: Block Turntimber Basilisk with Young Pyromancer AND block Garruk's Harbinger with Living Lightning, taking only 6 total damage (4 trample + 2 token), surviving at 1 life and getting Living Lightning's death trigger

annotations.description: Chose to kill a 2/2 Elemental Token with Hungry Flames instead of Garruk's Harbinger (4/3 with card advantage ability). Both die to 3 damage equally, but the Harbinger is a much bigger threat - it's a 4/3 that generates card advantage on combat damage. At 1 life, removing the larger attacker is more important.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Elemental Token (2/2) with Hungry Flames' 3 damage
annotations.betterLine: Target Garruk's Harbinger with Hungry Flames to remove the 4/3 card-advantage creature instead of a 2/2 token

annotations.description: Opponent is at 1 life with no creatures and mostly tapped lands. GPT53C Teach has Garruk's Harbinger (4/3) and Elemental Token (2/2) ready to attack for lethal. Activating Garruk before combat is unnecessary and gives the opponent an extra priority window with 2 untapped Mountains and 1 card in hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Garruk, Unleashed in precombat main phase before attacking for lethal.
annotations.betterLine: Skip straight to combat and attack with any creature for lethal damage. The opponent at 1 life with no blockers means any attacker wins the game immediately.
